problems: Pine trunk: the proposed full-height trunk reuses the shared ZoneMeshes.Cone mesh, which is built by ZoneMeshes.Build with no UVs. art.bark is Standard with the wood_grain texture, so the whole pole samples texel (0,0): a flat untextured cone where the old cylinder primitive had grain. Since the boughs are now sparse cards the trunk is visible top to bottom. Corrected edit below builds it with ZoneMeshes.Tube (grain, smooth normals, a small root swell, closed tip), no rng draws.

Great Oak fringe: the local function Fringe declares a parameter named 'turn' while GreatOak already has a method-level local 'float turn = T() * 360' (line 1340) in an enclosing scope. Name shadowing in nested functions is legal from C# 8 and the project is LangVersion 9, so it should compile, but it is the one construct in the patch that depends on that relaxation; renamed to 'phase' in the corrected edit to remove the doubt.

Bounds claim is optimistic: a cluster card's 'across' axis is rolled 0-180 degrees about the fan axis, so a card 2.3-3 m wide can stand its half-width vertically; a broadleaf crown's renderer box can be up to about 1 m taller than the old top clump, not 0.3 m. Harmless (colliders, NavBlocker and ZoneContentTests use colliders only; TreeFade's whole-tree box only widens the quick reject), but the risk note should say ~1 m.

AT-RISK anchor confirmed: the Great Oak insertion anchors on 'cap.center = new Vector3(0, 3.2f, 0); cap.height = 6.4f; cap.radius = 1.1f;' which is unique today (line 1381) and not inside the other agent's current diff hunks, but it is in the Great Oak region they may touch; re-check before applying.

Minor: the Pine edit still lazily initialises 'cone' although Pine no longer uses it (Tower, lantern and other props initialise it themselves); dropped in the corrected edit. ZoneBuilder.cs, ZoneMeshes.cs and the shaders use LF line endings; apply edits with tools that match exactly (verified).

correctedEdits.why: Replaces the un-UV'd cone trunk with a ZoneMeshes.Tube pole (bark grain, smooth normals, root swell, closed tip; no rng draws) and drops Pine's now-unused lazy cone init. Tiers, leader, materials, the 27 zone draws (h, pick, 5 x ox/oz/tiltX/turn/tiltZ) and the collider are exactly as proposed.

correctedEdits.oldString: var cap = t.gameObject.AddComponent<CapsuleCollider>(); cap.center = new Vector3(0, 3.2f, 0); cap.height = 6.4f; cap.radius = 1.1f;
correctedEdits.why: AT-RISK (Great Oak region another agent may edit; anchor unique today at line 1381 and outside their current diff hunks). Same insertion as proposed with the Fringe parameter 'turn' renamed to 'phase' so it no longer shadows GreatOak's method-level local 'turn' (legal in C# 8+/LangVersion 9, but needlessly relies on it). Calls are positional, so nothing else changes.

review.notes: Checked against the current working tree (D:\code\mmo, uncommitted edits from the other agent present in ZoneBuilder.cs lines 1203-1210 and 1675-1800 and in ZoneMeshes.Blob): every one of the 12 oldStrings occurs exactly once (script-verified with LF normalisation; files are LF). Broadleaf/Pine/orchard anchors and the ZoneMeshes Quad anchor do not overlap those hunks. Zone rng: Broadleaf takes h, yawA, yawB, family, clumps, then per clump a, (r), (s), Canopy, (y), yaw with the same short-circuit conditionals, then tree-stream bark, r0, Bole, bearings, per-limb from/radius; LeafCrown draws only from tr afterwards. Pine takes h, pick, then 5 x (ox, oz, tiltX, turn, tiltZ) = 27 draws in the old order. Orchard takes h, pick, per clump s, Canopy, x, y, z, yaw plus tree-stream from/reach, fruit unchanged. Great Oak fringe draws from the oak's own stream after every Clump (OakRing has its own seed). Shaders: CGINCLUDE + surface pass + explicit ShadowCaster mirrors the existing Fade.shader pattern; _MainTex_ST is declared only in the ShadowCaster pass (the surface generator emits it for uv_MainTex); Input.color : COLOR, vertex:vert with appdata_full, clip() in surf and Cull [_Cull] are all supported in built-in surface shaders; crown normals baked in ZoneMeshes.Cards make Cull Off correct without VFACE. Fade template gains _Cutoff 0, _Wind 0, _VertexTint 0, _Cull 2 defaults, so every existing fade copy is a no-op change; TreeFade.FadeOf copies the six floats only for Crulanda/Leaf, and the ShadowCaster's clip(tex.a - 0) never cuts opaque textures (all tree textures are RGB24 or the default white). CameraAndTargetTests only needs the first child renderer to swap to Crulanda/Fade and back; Trunk (Bole or the corrected pine Tube) stays first. ZoneArt.asset on disk lacks fade/post/waterSurface already, so leafCards/pineBough being regenerated by EnsureArt on validation builds matches the established flow; Chris's editor project shows flat Foliage/Pine rectangles on the card meshes until he runs Build Oakhaven (as flagged). Tex() writes the four PNGs once per copy; robocopy /MIR from the repo regenerates them in the validation copy. Cost: one Leaves + one Boughs mesh per broadleaf, one Boughs mesh per pine, one material per leaf family / four pine tints, static batching untouched. Leaf.shader.meta GUID is not used elsewhere in Assets. Suggested tuning only: 128 px cluster cards are soft up close; the generators are hard-coded to 128, so a 256 version would need its pixel constants doubled.
